title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
这一天，广寒宫里冷冷飕飕，嫦娥让玉兔去找吴刚要一坛桂花酒。
“让我自己去吗？”玉兔问。
“是呀。”嫦娥摸摸玉兔的脑袋，“路不是很远，你自己去应该没有问题。怎么了？”
“没……没事。”玉兔支支吾吾地回答。实际上，它很害怕。以前每次见吴刚，都是嫦娥带它去，它仍然怕得缩在嫦娥身后。这回要自己去，玉兔更害怕。可它不想让嫦娥觉得自己胆小，只能壮起胆子去找吴刚。
page_text_en:
One day, it was cold and chilly in the Moon Palace. Chang'e asked the Jade Rabbit to go find Wu Gang and ask for a jar of osmanthus wine.
"Should I go by myself?" the Jade Rabbit asked.
"Yes," Chang'e said, stroking the rabbit's head. "The path isn't very far. You should be fine. What's wrong?"
"N-no... nothing," the Jade Rabbit stammered. In truth, it was very afraid. Every time it had seen Wu Gang before, Chang'e had taken it. It still trembled and hid behind Chang'e. This time, having to go alone made the rabbit even more frightened. But it didn't want Chang'e to think it was cowardly, so it mustered up its courage and decided to go find Wu Gang.
summary_zh: 嫦娥让玉兔独自去广寒宫找吴刚要桂花酒，玉兔虽然害怕，但为了不让嫦娥觉得它胆小，还是鼓起勇气答应了。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
来到离桂树不远的地方，玉兔看见吴刚挥动斧子，想起听过的传说，害怕得小兔子心快要跳出胸口。
桂树旁边刚好有一块大石头，玉兔躲到大石头后面，探头看一眼吴刚，又缩回脑袋，犹豫着是鼓起勇气去见吴刚，还是失败地回广寒宫。
就在这时，一条舌头从上方伸到它眼前。
“啊啊啊啊啊！”玉兔吓得尖叫起来。
page_text_en:
Coming to a place not far from the osmanthus tree, the Jade Rabbit saw Wu Gang swinging his axe and, remembering the legend, was so frightened that her little rabbit heart was about to jump out of her chest.
There was just a big stone beside the tree. The Jade Rabbit hid behind it, peeked out at Wu Gang, then pulled her head back, hesitating whether to gather her courage to meet Wu Gang or to return to the Moon Palace in failure.
Just then, a tongue stretched down from above, right in front of her.
"Ah! Ah! Ah! Ah! Ah!" the Jade Rabbit screamed in terror.
summary_zh: 玉兔来到桂树附近，因害怕吴刚而躲在石头后犹豫不决，突然一条舌头从上方伸出，吓得她尖叫起来。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
“对不起，我没有想吓唬你，只是打个招呼。”声音从上方传来。原来，大石块上趴着一只胖乎乎的蟾蜍，刚才吐舌头的就是它。“不过……”蟾蜍垂着眼睛望向玉兔，问，“你为什么要躲在石头后面？

“嫦娥让我来找吴刚要一坛桂花酒。”玉兔回答，“但是……我害怕。”
“为什么害怕？”“害怕吴刚呀。”玉兔说，“你没有听说过吴刚被罚砍桂树的传说？”“哪个传说？”
page_text_en:
"Sorry, I didn't mean to scare you, just saying hello." A voice came from above. It turned out a plump toad was lying on the big rock, the one who had just stuck out its tongue. "Well..." the toad looked down at the jade rabbit with drooping eyes and asked, "Why are you hiding behind the rock?"

"Chang'e sent me to ask Wu Gang for a jar of osmanthus wine," the jade rabbit replied, "but... I'm scared."
"Why are you scared?" "Scared of Wu Gang," the jade rabbit said, "Have you not heard the legend of Wu Gang being punished to chop down the osmanthus tree?" "Which legend?"
summary_zh: 玉兔被蟾蜍的舌头吓到后，蟾蜍向它道歉并询问其躲藏的原因。玉兔解释自己是为嫦娥来取桂花酒，但害怕吴刚，蟾蜍则询问她是否听说过吴刚被罚砍桂树的传说。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
“啥？”蟾蜍咕哝一声。
“你就是吴刚儿子变的蟾蜍？”玉兔望着蟾蜍小心地问。
“据传说，”玉兔踮起脚，凑近蟾蜍耳边小声讲，“吴刚在学习仙术时犯了大罪——杀死了炎帝的后代伯陵，所以被惩罚在月亮上砍桂树。是不是很可怕！”
它想了想，又补充，“据传说，吴刚的妻子担心他在月亮上太孤单，就把儿子变成蟾蜍送到月亮上陪他。”
page_text_en:
"What?" the toad mumbled.
"Are you the toad transformed from Wu Gang's son?" the jade rabbit asked the toad cautiously.
"According to legend," the jade rabbit tiptoed closer and whispered into the toad's ear, "Wu Gang committed a great sin while learning immortality—killing the descendant of Emperor Yan, Bo Ling—so he was punished to chop the osmanthus tree on the moon. Isn't that terrifying!"
It thought for a moment, then added, "According to legend, Wu Gang's wife, worried he would be too lonely on the moon, turned her son into a toad and sent him to accompany him."
summary_zh: 玉兔向蟾蜍讲述吴刚因犯大罪被罚在月宫砍桂树的传说，并提到吴刚的妻子将儿子变成蟾蜍来陪伴他的故事。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
“胡说八道！我才不是！”蟾蜍气鼓鼓地叫道，“他来月亮之前，我就在这里！我一直在这里！”
“咦，那传说不是真的？”玉兔歪歪脑袋。
“还有另一个传说，与你刚才讲的有点像。”蟾蜍讲起来，“这个传说也说吴刚在学习仙术时犯了错。不过没有杀人哦！只是学习太懒惰，又骄傲自满，四处炫耀学到的小把戏、欺骗他人。师父非常生气，就把他送到月亮上来砍桂树了。”
page_text_en:
"Nonsense! I'm not!" the toad shouted angrily, "I was here before he came to the moon! I've always been here!"
"Huh, so that legend isn't true?" the jade rabbit tilted her head.
"There's another legend, similar to the one you just told," the toad began, "This one also says that Wu Gang made a mistake while learning immortality. But he didn't kill anyone! He was just lazy, arrogant, and proud, showing off his little tricks and deceiving others. His master was very angry, so he was sent to the moon to chop down the osmanthus tree."
summary_zh: 蟾蜍反驳玉兔关于吴刚传说的说法，声称自己在吴刚来月宫前就已存在，并讲述了另一个版本的传说：吴刚因学习仙术时懒惰、骄傲、炫耀和欺骗他人而被师父惩罚到月宫砍桂树。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
“原来是这样？”玉兔听到这传说，不像刚才那么害怕吴刚了。
“我也不知道。”蟾蜍打了个哈欠，“关于砍桂树的吴刚，有很多传说。”
“你还听过什么传说？”
“唔……我想想。”胖乎乎的蟾蜍眯起眼睛，“对了，还有人说吴刚是因为喜欢嫦娥才会到月亮上。”
“瞎说！”玉兔叫起来，恼火地踢了一下后腿，“才不是这样！肯定不是这样的！”
page_text_en:
"So that's how it is?" The Jade Rabbit, after hearing this legend, was no longer as afraid of Wu Gang as before.
"I don't know either," the toad yawned, "There are many legends about Wu Gang, who chops the osmanthus tree."
"What other legends have you heard?"
"Hmm... let me think," the plump toad squinted, "Oh, right, some say Wu Gang came to the moon because he liked Chang'e."
"Nonsense!" the Jade Rabbit cried out, angrily kicking her hind leg, "That's not true! It's definitely not like that!"
summary_zh: 玉兔听完蟾蜍讲述的关于吴刚的另一个传说后，表示不相信，并反驳说吴刚不可能是因为喜欢嫦娥才到月亮上，表现出她对这个版本的强烈否定。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
蟾蜍咕咕咕地笑着：“有这种传说，不等于这种传说就是真的。你可以试着问问吴刚，哪种传说是真的。”
玉兔犹豫一下，还是有些紧张地从大石块后钻出来，走到桂树下，小声对吴刚说：“您好！”
“你好啊，玉兔。”吴刚一边砍树，一边温和地问候。
看到吴刚这样温和，玉兔几乎完全不怕了。
“我想问……您为什么会来月亮上砍树呢？”
“稍等一下。”吴刚答道。
page_text_en:
The toad chuckled: "Just because there's a legend doesn't mean it's true. You can try asking Wu Gang which one is real." 
Yutu hesitated for a moment, still a bit nervous, and crawled out from behind the big rock, walking to the osmanthus tree and softly saying to Wu Gang, "Hello!" 
"Hello, Yutu," Wu Gang replied warmly while chopping the tree. 
Seeing Wu Gang so gentle, Yutu was almost completely unafraid. 
"I was wondering... why did you come to the moon to chop trees?" 
"Just a moment," Wu Gang answered.
summary_zh: 玉兔在蟾蜍的鼓励下鼓起勇气接近吴刚，向他询问为何在月亮上砍树，吴刚则温和回应并表示稍等。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
就在这时，一只乌鸦落在桂树上，大叫了三声：“嘎！嘎！嘎！”
听到乌鸦叫，吴刚把斧头放下来，擦了擦额头上的汗。
玉兔又问了一遍：“您为什么要砍桂树？”
“嘎嘎嘎。”乌鸦听到了，从桂树树枝上飞下来，嘎嘎地说，“吴刚砍桂树的传说，我也有一个，你们想听吗？”
“想！”玉兔、蟾蜍和吴刚一起回答。
page_text_en:
At that moment, a crow landed on the osmanthus tree and cried out three times: "Caw! Caw! Caw!"
Hearing the crow, Wu Gang put down his axe and wiped the sweat from his forehead.
Yutu asked again: "Why are you chopping the osmanthus tree?"
"Caw caw caw." The crow, having heard, flew down from the tree branch and said, "I also have a legend about Wu Gang chopping the osmanthus tree. Do you want to hear it?"
"Yes!" Yutu, the toad, and Wu Gang answered together.
summary_zh: 一只乌鸦落在桂树上大叫，吴刚停下砍树的动作擦汗，玉兔再次询问他为何砍树，乌鸦表示自己也有一个关于吴刚砍树的传说，并得到玉兔、蟾蜍和吴刚的共同回应愿意倾听。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
于是，乌鸦讲起来：
在很久很久以前，地上爆发了一场大瘟疫。
疾病像野火一样蔓延，人们一个接一个病倒，躺在屋子里哭泣。
吴刚的母亲也病倒了，痛苦不堪。
page_text_en:
Then, the crow began to tell: 
Long, long ago, a great plague broke out on Earth. 
Disease spread like wildfire, and people fell ill one after another, lying in their houses and crying. 
Wugang's mother also fell ill, suffering greatly.
summary_zh: 乌鸦开始讲述一个关于吴刚的传说，描述很久以前人间爆发大瘟疫，人们纷纷病倒，吴刚的母亲也深受其苦。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
吴刚决定，无论如何也要治好母亲的病。
他进入人迹罕至的深山，攀上一座陡峭的悬崖，在崖壁生长的珍奇植物中寻找能治疗这种疾病的草药。
实在是精疲力竭，他就钻进崖壁上的一个岩洞里，睡了一会儿。
吴刚做了一个神奇的梦，他梦到月亮上桂树的桂花是治疗这种疾病的最佳药物。
page_text_en:
Wu Gang decided that no matter what, he had to cure his mother's illness.
He entered a remote mountain, climbed a steep cliff, and searched among the rare plants growing on the cliff face for herbs that could cure the disease.
Exhausted, he crawled into a cave in the cliff and took a nap.
Wu Gang had a wonderful dream. In it, he dreamed that the osmanthus flowers from the osmanthus tree on the moon were the best medicine for this illness.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了吴刚为治好母亲的病，进入深山寻药，在精疲力尽时于岩洞中入睡，并梦见月亮上的桂花是治疗疾病的良药。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
吴刚醒过来，把头探出岩洞口，向上张望。
他看到，月亮刚好在悬崖顶端，而悬崖本身就像一道通向月亮的天梯。
吴刚立刻顺着崖壁向上攀去，到达悬崖顶部时，他就到达了月亮。
page_text_en:
Wu Gang woke up, poked his head out of the cave entrance, and looked upward.
He saw that the moon was just at the top of the cliff, and the cliff itself was like a ladder leading to the moon.
Wu Gang immediately climbed up the cliff face; when he reached the top of the cliff, he had arrived at the moon.
summary_zh: 吴刚在梦中得知月亮上的桂花可治母亲之病，醒来后看到月亮在悬崖顶端，便顺着崖壁攀爬，最终到达了月亮。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
月亮上果然有一棵高大的桂树，枝上开满芬芳的桂花。
该怎样把桂花带到地下呢？
吴刚想，该怎样把尽可能多的桂花带下去，救尽可能多的人？
他想到一个好主意！吴刚爬上桂树，摇动树枝，桂花纷纷飘落，从天空中的月亮上撒落下去。
桂花落进大江大河，人们喝了江河里的水，病就好了。吴刚妈妈的病也好了。
page_text_en:
There was indeed a tall osmanthus tree on the moon, its branches covered with fragrant blossoms.
How could he bring the blossoms down to earth?
Wu Gang thought, how could he bring as many blossoms as possible down to save as many people as possible?
He had a brilliant idea! Wu Gang climbed the osmanthus tree, shook its branches, and the blossoms fluttered down from the moon in the sky.
The blossoms fell into rivers and streams. When people drank the water, their illnesses were cured. Wu Gang’s mother’s illness was cured too.
summary_zh: 吴刚到达月亮后，发现桂树上开满桂花，他摇动树枝让桂花飘落，人们饮用含有桂花的江河水后病愈，包括他的母亲。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
没想到，天神们认为吴刚偷走了桂花，让他们没法做桂花馅甜饼，就惩罚吴刚留在月亮上砍伐桂树，砍倒才可以离开。
可是，这棵桂树是砍不倒、死不了的。吴刚在树身上砍出的缺口，很快就会愈合。
吴刚得永远留在月亮上，永远砍桂树，没有结果，却不得停歇。
page_text_en:
Unexpectedly, the gods thought Wu Gang had stolen the osmanthus flowers, preventing them from making osmanthus-filled pastries, so they punished Wu Gang to stay on the moon and chop down the osmanthus tree, only allowed to leave once it was felled.
However, this osmanthus tree cannot be chopped down or killed. The cuts Wu Gang makes on the tree quickly heal.
Wu Gang must forever remain on the moon, forever chopping the osmanthus tree, with no end in sight, yet never allowed to stop.
summary_zh: 乌鸦讲述的传说中，吴刚因偷取桂花被天神惩罚，必须永远在月亮上砍伐桂树，但桂树砍不倒、死不了，伤口会愈合，因此他永无止境地劳作，无法离开。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
“是这样吗？”玉兔问吴刚。
“那是他的工作呀！”一个声音说。
大家一起向声音传来的方向望，原来是嫦娥走过来。
她微笑着抱起玉兔，说：“你们没有想过，为什么桂树被砍会恢复，月亮缺了会再圆吗？”
“哦。”玉兔说，其实它还是不明白。
page_text_en:
"Is that so?" asked the Jade Rabbit, looking at Wu Gang.
"That's his job!" a voice said.
Everyone looked toward the direction of the voice, and it was Chang'e who had come over.
She smiled and picked up the Jade Rabbit, saying, "Have you ever thought about why the osmanthus tree heals after being cut, and why the moon becomes full again after being crescent?"
"Oh," said the Jade Rabbit, "actually, I still don't understand."
summary_zh: 嫦娥出现并抱起玉兔，向玉兔、蟾蜍和吴刚提出疑问：为何桂树被砍后能恢复，月亮缺了又会圆，玉兔表示仍不明白。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
page_text_ocr_zh:
吴刚微笑着从桂树根下取出一只酒坛，在大石头上摆上酒杯。
大家围拢在树下，一起喝起桂花酒。
地面上，妈妈抱着孩子看着天上的月亮。
“妈妈，月亮弯弯的，好像一只小船呢。”孩子说。
“对啊，月亮在慢慢长大。”妈妈说，“等到十五，它就会变圆了。”
page_text_en:
Wu Gang smiled as he took out a wine jar from under the osmanthus tree and placed cups on a big stone.
Everyone gathered under the tree and drank osmanthus wine together.
On the ground, a mother held her child and looked up at the moon in the sky.
"Mommy, the moon is curved, like a little boat," the child said.
"That's right, the moon is slowly growing," the mother said, "By the 15th, it will become round again."
summary_zh: 吴刚与众人在月宫下饮酒赏月，地面上一位母亲抱着孩子仰望月亮，孩子将弯月比作小船，母亲解释月亮会逐渐变圆。

title_en: Wu Gang Chopping the Osmanthus Tree
summary_zh: 画面中，嫦娥身着粉色长裙，飘带飞扬，立于云间，手中捧着一株桂花树，身旁有一只红色的小兔子。背景是明亮的月亮和一座古典楼阁，周围云雾缭绕，营造出月宫仙境的氛围。
